probes.name: copy-cells
probes.source:
Function Attempt() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Range("A1").Copy Destination:=Range("D1")
Attempt="OK"
Exit Function
Failed:
Attempt="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As Object
Range("A1").Value2=5
Range("D1").Value2=9
Range("G1").Formula="=Attempt()"
Probe=CStr(Range("G1").Value2) & "|D1=" & CStr(Range("D1").Value2) & "|rules=" & CStr(Range("D1").FormatConditions.Count)
Application.CutCopyMode=False
End Function

probes.name: copy-conditional
probes.source:
Function Attempt() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Range("A1").Copy Destination:=Range("D1")
Attempt="OK"
Exit Function
Failed:
Attempt="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As Object
Range("A1").Value2=5
Range("D1").Value2=9
Set f=Range("A1").FormatConditions.Add(2,Formula1:="=A1>0")
f.Font.Bold=True
Range("G1").Formula="=Attempt()"
Probe=CStr(Range("G1").Value2) & "|D1=" & CStr(Range("D1").Value2) & "|rules=" & CStr(Range("D1").FormatConditions.Count)
Application.CutCopyMode=False
End Function
